uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:hook.text: There's a grain of rice on this cat's fur. And it's moving.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:mochi.text: This is Mochi. She's a cat.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:grain.text: That grain isn't rice. It's a tiny piece of a tapeworm... packed with eggs.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:dry.text: It dries, breaks open, and the eggs spill into Mochi's bed.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:pip.text: Down in the bed lives Pip. He's a flea. Well... a baby flea.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:eats.text: Pip eats the crumbs he finds. Including a tapeworm egg.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:inside.text: Inside Pip, the egg hatches. A young worm slips into his body... and waits.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:cocoon.text: Pip spins a cocoon, and comes out a grown-up flea.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:warm.text: In Mochi's warm fur, the tiny worm inside him gets ready.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:itch.text: Pip's bite itches. So Mochi licks her fur clean...

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:swallow.text: and swallows Pip, along with the worm inside him.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:noodle.text: This is Noodle. She's a tapeworm.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:hooks.text: She holds on to Mochi's gut with a crown of tiny hooks and four suckers.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:mouth.text: Noodle has no mouth. She soaks up Mochi's food through her skin.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:grow.text: And she grows. Segment after segment. She can get longer than a ruler.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:eggs.text: Each new segment fills with eggs.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:leave.text: The oldest ones break off, crawl out... and end up on Mochi's fur.

uk7wwhXdWYHKKZ8KTCVw:cycle.text: Little grains of rice. Waiting for the next Pip.
